description: This file contains type definitions for the Long class, including its properties, constructors, static methods, and instance methods. It defines a union type LongLike that can accept multiple representations of 64-bit integers, facilitating usage within both ESM and UMD module formats.

classes.name: Long
classes.description: A class representing a 64-bit two's complement integer with various constructors and methods for arithmetic, bitwise operations, comparisons, and conversions.
